ns2:section.sectionText: The journalism industry is undergoing significant change. Current content delivery models are often not profitable. This class will serve as an incubator for developing unique and innovative journalistic content/programming,with the intent of reaching an audience of peers. We'll look for actual new ways to do journalism that can gain wider audiences by expanding the definition of what journalism is and can be. PREREQUISITES REQUIRED: JOUR 210 (or JOUR 400 or JOUR 501) and either JOUR 215 or JOUR 335.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s).
